---
name: Bug report
about: Report something that did not work as expected in SatRoverWatch
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## What happened?

Describe what you observed and what SatRoverWatch did that seemed wrong.

## What did you expect to happen?

Tell us what you expected SatRoverWatch to do instead.

## What was SatRoverWatch doing at the time?

If applicable, include anything that might help us understand the situation, such as the rover's activity, APRS behavior, grid location, satellite pass, map, weather report, or X post involved.

## Can it be reproduced?

If you know how to make the problem happen again, describe the steps here. If you don't know, that's okay.

## Anything else?

Add any screenshots, error messages, logs, links, or other information that might help investigate the problem.

**Please do not include API keys, passwords, private credentials, or other sensitive information.**

Thanks for helping improve SatRoverWatch!
